svg.title: CharacterChunker
svg.desc: CharacterChunker cuts the leave-policy text into 105 characters and makes 5 chunks of 30 characters that overlap by 6.
svg.text: CharacterChunker(chunk_size=30, overlap=6): windows of 30 characters, each starting 24 characters after the last one.
Orange frame = the chunk being made. Filled orange = overlap, repeated from the chunk before.
